theme: An open day, with two travel bookings quietly going overdue.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan — a rare clear stretch end to end. The week's real pressure is two travel bookings now past due, and the December trip's book-by date lands Thursday.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 task flags a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week; holiday inventory is thin, so a refundable hold now takes the risk off. Open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The December trip with all four girls (Dec 13-Jan 2) needs a call and a booking by Oct 15 — six people over three weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year.

needsAttention.title: Mom's care paperwork
needsAttention.detail: Tampa Gardens still hasn't answered your Oct 7 note about the form her insurer requested; a short nudge would move it.

flagged.detail: She's back Oct 31 and asked you to propose a slot; you'd flagged you'll both be at ICGN in Toronto.

acts.line: The calendar is empty top to bottom — no meetings pulling at the day.
A rare open stretch to spend on the one decision the week keeps circling back to.
Tomorrow opens early at nine, so tonight can wind down without a late push.
